cases.question: Tell me about Pdfroo
cases.judge_reason: The answer accurately describes Pdfroo as a client-side PDF editor with all details matching the expected facts and public facts.
cases.answer:
**Pdfroo** is Ayush's fully client-side PDF editor — open a PDF, annotate, sign, rearrange/merge pages, and download a real flattened PDF. Nothing ever leaves the browser; all parsing, rendering, and writing happen locally via **pdf.js + pdf-lib**, and it works offline once loaded.

**Highlights**
- **Zero backend, zero build step** — just open `index.html` or hit the live demo
- **Responsive**: phones (375 px), tablets (768 px), desktops (1440 px+) with mouse, pen, or touch
- **Pages panel**: thumbnail sidebar (desktop), slide-in drawer (tablet), bottom sheet (phone); drag-to-reorder via SortableJS, rotate, duplicate, delete, insert blank, merge PDFs
- **Find & replace**, **compress**, built-in sample PDF
- **Privacy-first**: after first successful download, a kangaroo toast confirms "Your PDF never left your device"
- **Light/dark theme**, local Fredoka/Nunito/Baloo 2 fonts, SVG kangaroo mascot

**Stack**: JavaScript, CSS, HTML (pdf.js, pdf-lib, SortableJS)  
**Repo**: [ayush4u/pdfroo](https://github.com/ayush4u/pdfroo) (MIT)  
**Live**: [ayush4u.github.io/pdfroo](https://ayush4u.github.io/pdfroo/)
